headline: Names a Postal Service building in Twentynine Palms, California, after Colonel M.J. "Mac" Dube of the Marine Corps.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the United States Postal Service facility at 73839 Gorgonio Drive in Twentynine Palms, California, as the "Colonel M.J. 'Mac' Dube, USMC Post Office Building." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 18, 2014, when it became law.
